instruction.text: Does the adjective mean good or bad? Choose the correct answer for each adjective.
Does the adjective mean happy or sad? Choose the correct answer for each adjective.
Replace the adjective to make the sentence more interesting.

atoms.a: Kate got really good marks in her end of year exams.
atoms.b: Kate got really ((awful terrible ++incredible)) marks in her end of year exams.

atoms.a: She was so sad when her kitten went missing.
atoms.b: She was so ((joyful ++miserable excited)) when her kitten went missing.

atoms.a: He felt bad when he forgot his mum’s birthday.
atoms.b: He felt ((amazing ++awful happy)) when he forgot his mum’s birthday.

atoms.a: Rue was happy when she saw her best friend again.
atoms.b: Rue was ((++exhilarated depressed annoyed)) when she saw her best friend.
